text:
divya: Hey — trying to open the eu model-health dashboard for svc-modeling but I'm getting a 403. I only see infra/service-overview dashboards. anyone know the canonical grafana link? 

sam: That should be the model-health-eu dashboard. link is https://grafana.redwood.com/d/9f2b-model-health-eu — but that is team-restricted. Do you get a grafana login page or a permissions error?

elena: 403 means missing Viewer role on the org/team group. @eng-platform can you confirm whether divya's account is in grafana-viewer or the eng-sre group? :eyes:

opsbot: Deploy> New dashboard published: model-health-eu by mike at 2026-02-03T14:22Z. Change set: added per-region node-metrics panel.

sam: FYI there's an internal vs public variant. The internal one has traces + full logs panels; public one is a trimmed-down view. If you need the full view it's a separate permission.

elena: If eng-platform wants to add her quickly, you can run:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-infra --member=user:divya@redwood.com --role=roles/logging.viewer
# and in Grafana add user to grafana-viewer:eng-sre
```

sam: I can do the Grafana side. divya, what's your SSO email?

divya: divya@redwood.com (SSO via okta). Thanks. I'm trying to pull the per-model latency + KV cache hit rate panels to debug a latency spike.

mike: heads-up — the alert rule for model-health-eu currently fires on p95 latency > 400ms for 2m. That was slightly aggressive after the recent quantized model rollout. We should maybe relax to 500ms or 5m window.

elena: noted — filing an alert-tuning ticket after we confirm graphs. @sam, can you add divya to grafana-viewer and also check that she has logs access in Cloud Logging?

sam: done on Grafana side: added divya@redwood.com to group grafana-viewer:eng-sre at 1778501305. For cloud logs I requested logging.viewer via IAM ticket (ticket #INC-9468).

divya: I can now see the dashboard — panels look good, thanks! I can also access traces link.

elena: great. For the alert change: mike, can you propose new thresholds in the ticket and we'll route to oncall for approval?

mike: will do, creating a small PR + alert rule update in infra-alerts repo and link it in INC-9468.

divya: one quick note — log query that helped me locate the KV miss spike:
```
resource.type=\"k8s_container\" AND labels.k8s-pod/app=\"svc-modeling\"
jsonPayload.kv_cache_hit=false | stats count() by jsonPayload.model, jsonPayload.shard
```

sam: perfect. marking thread resolved for access; follow-up for alert tuning in INC-9468. :white_check_mark:
